steps.why: glob plus version sort plus count; identical output every run

proposed_script.name: list_changelogs.py
proposed_script.stdout: {count, files:[{path, version, date}]} sorted by version ascending
proposed_script.exit: 0 files found / 1 no changelog files / 2 usage or unreadable dir

steps.why: fixed regex check on the first heading; same rule every run

proposed_script.name: check_headings.py
proposed_script.stdout: {findings:[{file, issue, line}]} with issue missing_version_header or malformed_version_header
proposed_script.exit: 0 clean / 1 findings / 2 usage or unreadable dir

steps.why: per-category tally and totals; arithmetic, not judgment

proposed_script.name: count_entries.py
proposed_script.stdout: {per_file:[{file, version, date, counts}], totals:{category: n}, total_entries}
proposed_script.exit: 0 entries counted / 1 no entries found / 2 usage or unreadable dir

steps.why: the narrative is prose written for a non-technical reader; wording, emphasis and framing should differ run to run, and count_entries.py already hands it every fact it needs, so no mechanical shell is left to strip
fixed markdown table rendered from the counts, sorted by version descending; a template, not a decision

proposed_script.name: render_table.py
proposed_script.stdout: markdown table: version, date, one column per category, total; version descending
proposed_script.exit: 0 every row complete / 1 a row has an unknown version or date / 2 usage or unreadable dir

steps.why: tag-against-allowed-list is a fixed set check the script does; whether a Misc entry belongs under another category is contextual re-triage the script must not fake

proposed_script.name: check_tags.py
proposed_script.stdout: {invalid:[{file, tag, line}], misc:[{file, line, text}]} - invalid is mechanical, misc is the residue Claude re-triages
proposed_script.exit: 0 no invalid tags and no misc entries / 1 invalid tags or misc entries present / 2 usage or unreadable dir

steps.why: enumerating every entry with neutral length facts is mechanical; whether a reader finds an entry confusing is judgment no script should encode

proposed_script.name: list_entries.py
proposed_script.stdout: {entries:[{file, version, category, line, text, word_count, char_count}]} - facts only, no clarity verdict
proposed_script.exit: 0 entries listed / 1 no entries found / 2 usage or unreadable dir
